Beat 'cut' ('Then Starbucks cut his pay, all the way down to $31M'), the description ('Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol's pay was cut') and the 'gap' beat built on it say something the source does not. The proxy shows FY2024's $95,801,676 was mostly $90.3M of one-time replacement RSUs/PRSUs for the Chipotle equity he forfeited on joining (Sept 2024, about 3 weeks of FY2024), plus $5M sign-on cash; Starbucks did not cut his pay, the one-time hiring awards fell away (FY25 target pay $39.2M was his first normal year). Rewrite e.g. 'The year before, he got $95.8M, mostly one-time stock to replace what he left at Chipotle. His first normal year: $31M.' and fix the description and the 'gap' line ('So is he any closer to her now?') to match; drop the boardroom-scissors 'cut' picture.

Beat 'promise' ('Her boss, Brian Niccol, got $95.8M the year before') hides the decisive context that this was a joining package for a few weeks of work, mostly stock valued at grant; say it is one-time replacement stock or leave the FY2024 figure out.

Facts confirmed on the SEC page itself (Starbucks 2026 DEF 14A, fetched): Summary Compensation Table total $30,992,773 (FY2025) and $95,801,676 (FY2024); pay ratio section: median employee 'a part-time barista in the U.S.', $17,279, ratio 1,794 to 1. Verify items hold (total compensation, not wage; per-hour line says 'spread over every hour of the year'). Minor: description 'Sources: Starbucks 2026 proxy statement (Sep 2025)' should read the proxy (Jan 2026), fiscal year to Sep 2025; disclaimer present.
